item.title: Darth Vader's light saber used in ‘I am your father’ duel sells for nearly $5 million
item.description: A light saber used by Darth Vader in the “Star Wars” movies “The Empire Strikes Back” and ”Return of the Jedi” sold Thursday for nearly $5 million in an auction.

item.title: Democrat Cindy Holscher is elected Kansas' next governor, extending her party's wave of victories
item.description: Democrat Cindy Holscher has been elected Kansas' next governor. The state senator fended off Republican Ty Masterson to extend a massive wave of Democratic victories nationwide.

item.title: Donald Trump Jr. exits advisory role at prediction market Kalshi
item.description: Donald Trump Jr. is no longer a paid adviser for Kalshi, the prediction market company said Thursday.

item.title: US officer accused of Russian spying is set to be charged in UK, official says
item.description: An American Army officer who was arrested in the United Kingdom on suspicion of spying for Russia had not handed over any information to Moscow and he's expected to be charged in Britain in the coming days.

item.title: Ex-Oklahoma death row inmate Richard Glossip pleads guilty to lesser charge in 1997 murder
item.description: Former Oklahoma death row prisoner Richard Glossip pleads guilty to a lesser charge after nearly 30 years in prison.
